refusals.name: a non-shortest head on the outer array
the outer array holds three items
envelope key 7, cuts that are not event IDs
a unit with no log: only rosters and device lists start a log
kind 7: must be understood, and unknown
an ed of small order (signature left zero)
a scheme-2 event whose author's keys are not held: only another device's hash to another kc
the ML-DSA-65 half made by another device's key, under this device's ed and kc

chains.name: a restore that writes before it syncs: two events at seq 2
a restore that fetches its latest sequence first
a prev that is another device's event
one body signed twice by a deterministic signer is one event
a second unit at seq 2 this replica cannot open is still evidence
the same event signed again with another nonce is the same event
two events at seq 2 that carry one Ed25519 key under two kc: two authors, no fork
